segments.sn8.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeheva arahantehi.
segments.sn8.10:1.2: Tesaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno cetasā cittaṃ samannesati [samanvesati (syā. aṭṭha.)] vippamuttaṃ nirupadhiṃ.
segments.sn8.10:1.4: “ayaṃ kho bhagavā rājagahe viharati isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeheva arahantehi.
segments.sn8.10:1.5: Tesaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno cetasā cittaṃ samannesati vippamuttaṃ nirupadhiṃ.
segments.sn8.10:1.6: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ bhagavato sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyan”ti.
segments.sn8.10:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn8.10:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ bhagavato sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi –

lines: Paccavekkhatīti tesaṃ ariyānaṃ cittaṃ attano ñāṇacakkhunā pati avekkhati paccavekkhati.
Sabbaguṇasampannanti sabbehi buddhaguṇehi ca sāvakaguṇehi ca paripuṇṇaṃ.
Anekākārasampannanti rūpaghosalūkhadhammappamāṇikānaṃ sattānaṃ tehi tehi ākārehi sabbesañca anekehi anantāparimeyyehi pasīditabbākārehi samannāgataṃ.
Te pana ākārā yasmā anaññasādhāraṇā buddhaguṇā eva, tasmā āha “anekehi guṇehi samannāgatan”ti.
